lead_in: Ephesians 5:31–32 reads Genesis’ “two in one flesh” as a great mystery of Christ and the Church; Augustine hears Head and Body.

excerpt.text: For Christ is the Head of the Body. The Head is in Heaven, the Body is on earth; the Head is the Lord, the Body His Church. But ye remember it is said, They shall be two in one flesh. This is a great mystery, says the Apostle, but I speak in Christ and in the Church. If then they are two in one flesh, they are two in one voice.
excerpt.attribution: St Augustine, Sermon 79 on the New Testament (Ben. 129), §4, in Nicene and Post-Nicene Fathers, series 1, vol. 6
